notes.content: Students must earn a "C" grade or higher in all courses applied to the Art History major. Additional Art History requirement: Select one lower-division course from Photography or Art Studio in a medium other than drawing. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Art History is compatible with the B.A. in Art History at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better. All lower-division core requirements in Art History must be completed prior to enrollment in upper-division courses at Sacramento State. Art History students are required to meet the Sacramento State Foreign Language Requirement by completing the second semester (1B) of a college-level foreign language course with a grade of C- or better (or equivalent foreign language study, as described in the current University catalog ). Students who plan to pursue further graduate study in art history are encouraged to learn a foreign language relevant to their art historical interests through the second semester intermediate level (2B). For additional information, please visit: Department of Art .

  4. All lower-division core requirements in Art History must be completed prior to enrollment in upper-division courses at Sacramento State.
  5. Students who plan to pursue further graduate study in art history are encouraged to learn a foreign language relevant to their art historical interests through the second semester intermediate level (2B).
  6. For additional information, please visit: Department of Art.
